notes.title: New Squads Update – Fresh Cards & Abilities!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604752/640eedf776380b46d0adbaef28aa4bf6acbb0ff4.png"]🥷 Major Update – New Squads Arrive!

The world of Rogue Ninjas is expanding! This update brings brand-new squads, each with their own unique cards, abilities, and strategies to master. Whether you prefer raw power, cunning tricks, or tactical control, there’s something here to shake up your runs.
[hr][/hr]✨ What’s New
New Squads – Unlock fresh teams of warriors with distinct fighting styles.

Unique Cards – Each squad comes with exclusive cards to build new combos.

Special Abilities – Experiment with never-before-seen powers to outsmart your enemies.

Strategic Variety – More options for deck-building and squad synergy.
[hr][/hr]🔧 Balance & Improvements
Re-tuned several existing cards for smoother progression.

Adjusted difficulty pacing for mid-game battles.

General performance optimizations and bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch Notes – Version 0.9.0
notes.content:
Hello players!
We’ve been working hard to improve your gameplay experience. This update focuses on important bug fixes and overall balance improvements. Here’s what’s new:

Bug Fixes

 Fixed several issues causing card-related bugs during play.

 Resolved a critical bug where cards were being duplicated during inventory management.


Balance Changes

 Adjusted card stats and abilities for better gameplay balance.

 Minor tuning to enemy difficulty and drop rates.


Thank you for all the feedbacks! Keep it coming, and stay tuned for more content and improvements in the next update.

notes.title: 🔧 Stability & Launch Fixes
notes.content:
Resolved frame drops and performance issues reported by some users
 Fixed an issue preventing the game from launching on certain Windows 10 systems
